capabilities: Capture every save as a snapshot via the Ginkgo Backup desktop engine
Diff any two versions of a file line by line
Preview and restore previous file versions
Browse snapshots on a calendar timeline sidebar
Schedule full vault backups including attachments
extras: Desktop only (Windows engine required; plugin cannot back up on mobile). Freemium: plugin is fully functional with the free version of Ginkgo Backup. Older snapshots beyond the 500 loaded in the timeline must be accessed in the desktop app.
intentEvidence: No Git knowledge required — No commits, branches, or push/pull. Just save, and it's backed up.
problem: Recovering earlier versions of notes in Obsidian relies on Git knowledge or manual snapshots; File Recovery offers no per-file history, diffing, or calendar browsing.
summary: Vault versioning client that pushes saves to the Ginkgo Backup desktop engine and lets you diff, preview, and restore snapshots from Obsidian.
